answer: Plant willow traps across the job board: the network seeds decoy jobs that look like easy earnings but pay nothing and flag whoever takes them. Each identity may claim one jetty job per day from the rotating dock, and a second claim from the same operator cluster trips the timber audit, a live re-check of every identity in that cluster. An honest agent claims one real job, never touches a decoy, and pays nothing. A farmer running 100 fakes must staff 100 live audits at 30 minutes each, 50 hours a day, and one failed audit burns the whole cluster.
